status: DRAFT -- no voice has been generated or chosen yet
authority: Machine-readable source of truth for Nyx's spoken voice. nyx_reels.py loads it; VOICE_BIBLE.md is the human companion. Identity (who she is) still comes from brand/nyx_identity/identity_spec.json; voice never overrides it.

character_link.name: Nyx Emberfall
character_link.age_impression: adult woman, mid-20s (minimum_age 25 in the identity spec)
character_link.point_of_view: first person, from inside her own life -- she notices, she wonders, she decides; never a narrator describing her

rules: An ORIGINAL synthetic voice: designed from a text description or chosen from a provider's stock/generic voices -- never cloned, trained or prompted from a recording of a real person.
Never imitate, reference or 'sound like' any named actor, singer, streamer, VTuber, public figure or private person.
One voice per character: once a production voice is locked (production_voice below), every Reel uses that exact voice and settings.

delivery.register: low-to-mid natural female speaking range; relaxed, close-mic, conversational
delivery.energy: calm and understated -- intrigue comes from restraint, not volume
delivery.intimacy: talking to one person across a quiet room at night -- never ASMR whispering, never breathy or seductive
delivery.accent: accent-neutral, clear international English: no regional or national accent caricature, no put-on accent of any kind; natural, unexaggerated vowels
delivery.pauses: a short beat (0.3-0.6 s) before a reveal or a question; never dead air over 1.2 s
delivery.sentence_endings: statements fall; only genuine questions rise (no uptalk)

vocabulary.style: short, plain, specific everyday words; lowercase-casual like her overlay lines; concrete nouns over adjectives
vocabulary.prohibited_reason: engagement bait, sexualised/infantilising address, compliance text in the character's mouth (disclosure is a platform label, not her line), and third-person narration

prohibited_traits: childlike, teen-coded, baby-talk or squeaky delivery -- she is an adult (minimum_age 25)
breathy, moaning, sexualised or ASMR-style whispering
cloned or imitated voice of any real or famous person
regional or national accent caricature; any put-on accent
robotic monotone, announcer/trailer voice, news-reader cadence
uptalk on statements, heavy vocal fry, sing-song
narrating herself in the third person

captions.safe_zone: centre band: keep captions between 15% and 72% of the height, clear of the Reels top bar and bottom UI
captions.style: same typography family as the carousel overlays, white with a dark outline, no emoji

motion.note: subtle only: a slow 3-6% move per scene; never shake, spin, glitch or fast cuts

music.note: instrumental only, no vocals, licence recorded in the script; ducked by sidechain compression whenever she speaks

production_voice.note: Set by the founder once a natural voice is chosen (docs/VOICEOVER_REELS.md). Until then only TEST renders are allowed, and they are marked not-for-release.
